_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: VictoriaMetrics
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: A fast time series database that takes metrics from Prometheus, InfluxDB, Graphite and OpenTelemetry, and answers PromQL queries. Everything is behind a password.
startup: pw="{{WEB_PASSWORD}}"; if [ -z "$pw" ]; then [ -s web-password.txt ] || (umask 077; head -c 18 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d "\n/+=" > web-password.txt); pw=$(cat web-password.txt); echo "Web password is empty, so VictoriaMetrics uses the password in web-password.txt (username {{WEB_USER}})."; fi; exec ./victoria-metrics -storageDataPath=data -httpListenAddr=:{{SERVER_PORT}} -retentionPeriod={{RETENTION}} -promscrape.config=scrape.yml -httpAuth.username="{{WEB_USER}}" -httpAuth.password="$pw" -memory.allowedPercent=60 -loggerTimezone="${TZ:-UTC}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# VictoriaMetrics: downloads the single-node release for the chosen version
# from GitHub (checked against GitHub's checksum). The data folder and
# scrape.yml are never touched; only the program is replaced, once the new
# one has arrived.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "VictoriaMetrics has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
tag=latest
if [ "$want" != latest ]; then tag="v${want#v}"; fi
tag=$(gh-release tag VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics "$tag") || fail "VictoriaMetrics has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 1.156.0, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"

if [ -x victoria-metrics ] && ./victoria-metrics -version 2>&1 | grep -q -- "-tags-v$version-"; then
    echo "VictoriaMetrics $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading VictoriaMetrics $version"
    gh-release download VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics "$tag" "victoria-metrics-linux-$arch-v$version.tar.gz" "$work/vm.tar.gz" ||
        fail "VictoriaMetrics $version has no single-node download for this CPU."
    tar -xzf "$work/vm.tar.gz" -C "$work"
    [ -x "$work/victoria-metrics-prod" ] || fail "The download isn't VictoriaMetrics. Reinstall to try again."
    mv -f "$work/victoria-metrics-prod" victoria-metrics
fi

mkdir -p data
if [ ! -f scrape.yml ]; then
    cat > scrape.yml <<'YML'
# Targets VictoriaMetrics scrapes itself, in Prometheus's format:
# https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#how-to-collect-metrics-in-prometheus-format
# Restart the server after changing it.
scrape_configs: []
YML
fi
echo "Installed VictoriaMetrics $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The VictoriaMetrics version to install, such as 1.156.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Web username
variables.description: The username for the web interface and API.

variables.name: Web password
variables.description: The password for the web interface and API. Leave it empty to use a random one, saved in web-password.txt.

variables.name: Data retention
variables.description: How long metrics are kept: a number of months, or a time such as 30d, 12w or 2y.
